about: Taste notes the weekly agent uses to set each event's base score (0-100). 'likes'/'lessLikely' are Aaron's; 'people' holds anyone else's. Calendar flags are learned per person on top of this.
likes: Repertory and revival film, noir, Hitchcock, Lynch; character actors and sad, humane stories
Electronic, experimental, ambient and microhouse-adjacent music; DJ nights at artist-run spaces
Jazz, especially adventurous or spiritual jazz in small rooms
DIY electronics, synths, maker fairs, hardware hacking
Historic architecture, old houses, Victorian history, walking tours
Photography and contemporary art exhibitions; small galleries
Storytelling, author talks, podcasts and interview-style events
lessLikely: Pub crawls and generic bar parties

stacey.note: Nothing stated yet; learned from her flags on the calendar.
